    Bug 1992956 - Port bug 1992386: set the default task expiration policy for try-comm-central to 28 days. r=vineet,tobyp DONTBUILD
    
    We seem to have logic elsewhere (the root `.taskcluster.yml` file) that sets
    this to 28 days after the fact anyway.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D267769

diff --git a/taskcluster/config.yml b/taskcluster/config.yml
index 698784fadbc..2efe4899c1a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/config.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/config.yml
@@ -384,11 +384,11 @@ expiration-policy:
             medium: 28 days
             long: 28 days
         try-comm-central:
-            default: 1 month
+            default: 28 days
             shortest: 7 days
             short: 14 days
-            medium: 1 month
-            long: 1 month
+            medium: 28 days
+            long: 28 days
         ash:
             default: 1 month
             shortest: 7 days
